item: On Windows the in-app stop button ended every session unclean: os.kill(SIGTERM) is TerminateProcess
summary: Release note: stopping the app with its power button on Windows now runs the normal clean shutdown (checkpoint, clean marker), so the next start no longer re-checks the whole database. Cause: the button sent SIGTERM to itself, which Windows turns into an immediate kill. Field bundle 2026-11-07 F7.
